32:21.text: And verily, We will make them taste of the near torment
(i.e. the torment in the life of this world, i.e. disasters, calamities, etc.)

32:22.text: And who does more wrong than he who is reminded of the Ayât
(proofs, evidence, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.)
of his Lord, then turns aside therefrom? Verily, We shall exact retribution from the Mujrimûn

32:23.text: So be not you in doubt of meeting him
So be not you in doubt of meeting him [i.e. when you met Mûsa
during the night of Al-Isrâ’ and Al-Mi‘râj
over the heavens]. And We made it
a guide to the Children of Israel.

32:24.text: And We made from among them
, leaders, giving guidance under Our Command, when they were patient and used to believe with certainty in Our Ayât
(proofs, evidence, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.)

32:25.text: Verily, your Lord will judge between them, on the Day of Resurrection, concerning that wherein they used to differ.

32:26.text: Is it not a guidance for them: how many generations We have destroyed before them in whose dwellings they do walk about? Verily, therein indeed are signs. Would they not then listen?

32:27.text: Have they not seen how We drive water to the dry land that has no vegetation, and therewith bring forth crops providing food for their cattle and themselves? Will they not then see?

32:28.text: (between us and you, i.e. the Day of Resurrection)
, if you are telling the truth?"

32:29.text: , no profit will it be to those who disbelieve if they
believe! Nor will they be granted a respite."
